description.summary: This table defines key terms used in a pollution liability insurance policy. It helps clarify the scope of coverage by defining dates and responsible parties.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום מגדירה את תאריך הרטרואקטיבי (Retroactive date) כפי שמצוין בסעיף 7 של ההצהרות, או בכל הסכם רלוונטי. תאריך זה קובע את התאריך המוקדם ביותר שבו אירוע זיהום יכול להתחיל כדי לקבל כיסוי ביטוחי. לדוגמה, אם תאריך רטרואקטיבי מצוין כ-1/1/2023, אירועי זיהום שהחלו לפני תאריך זה לא יהיו מכוסים.
notable_values: Retroactive date: earliest date for coverage
Responsible insured: person with compliance responsibility

sketch:
"Responsible  insured" means  a  "named  insured's"  principal,  partner,  director, officer, member or manager (in the case of a limited liability company), or employee with responsibility for compliance, environmental or legal affairs, or risk management.
"Retroactive  date" means  the  date  set  forth  in  Item  7  of  the  Declarations,  or  any applicable  endorsement,  which  is  the  earliest  date  that  a  'pollution  event'  can commence for coverage to be provided under the policy.  If no entry appears or the words NOT APPLICABLE or N/A appear in the corresponding space of Item 7 of the Declarations then a "retroactive date" shall not apply.

טבלה: הגדרות פוליסה
This table defines key terms used in a pollution liability insurance policy. It helps clarify the scope of coverage by defining dates and responsible parties.
ממדים: defined term, definition

"Responsible  insured" means  a  "named  insured's"  principal,  partner,  director, officer, member or manager (in the case of a limited liability company), or employee with responsibility for compliance, environmental or legal affairs, or risk management.
"Retroactive  date" means  the  date  set  forth  in  Item  7  of  the  Declarations,  or  any applicable  endorsement,  which  is  the  earliest  date  that  a  'pollution  event'  can commence for coverage to be provided under the policy.  If no entry appears or the words NOT APPLICABLE or N/A appear in the corresponding space of Item 7 of the Declarations then a "retroactive date" shall not apply.
